title: Production subaccounts must carry a costCenter label
description: All subaccounts marked usedForProduction must have a costCenter label for chargeback and FinOps governance.

title: Production subaccounts must carry a department label
description: Mirror of costCenter but for org-chart attribution.

title: Production destinations must not use BasicAuthentication
description: BasicAuth is forbidden in production. Use OAuth2*, ClientCertificate, or Principal Propagation.

title: No subaccount should be inactive for 90+ days
description: Inactive subaccounts incur cost and create an unowned attack surface. Decommission or document a clear reason.

title: Subaccount displayName must indicate tier
description: displayName should contain prod / qa / dev / sandbox so cockpit users know the environment at a glance.

title: Admin role collections must require MFA
description: IAS authentication policy must enforce MFA for any role-collection containing 'Admin'.
